name: reddit-feed-curator
description: Firefox extension that filters unwanted Reddit feed posts by category, subreddit, pattern and keyword. Entirely local.

scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename reddit-feed-curator-{version}.xpi --overwrite-dest
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run lint:ext
